name: AssociateParameterSet

parameters.help_en: The list of parameter set IDs to associate with the resource. Maximum length: 5

parameters.name: parameter_set_ids

parameters.help_en: The resource ID. When the resource type is ModuleVersion, the value is a concatenation of <moduleId>-<moduleversion>, such as mod-34535345df123fr-v3
parameters.help_zh:
资源ID
资源类型为ModuleVersion时，
由<moduleId>-<moduleversion>拼接而成，
如mod-34535345df123fr-v3
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

- Module: template
- ModuleVersion: template version
- Task: node
- Stack: resource stack
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值

- Module 模板
- ModuleVersion 模板版本
- Task 任务
- Stack 资源栈
parameters.name: resource_type
